limitations: The disposable server ran on this Linux aarch64 host; no Android device, installed client or Windows/macOS target was exercised.

The provider was a loopback stub (deterministic tokens, cost 0); no real model turn and no provider credential were used, so the live evidence proves the CodeWalk client contract, not provider behaviour.
The turn that produced the tool-originated permission was served by the stub; the model-origin continuation after approval is a stub behaviour.
The screenshots and installed-native acceptance of the same screens stay with V2-060A (accepted) and the MVP platform checkpoints.
